item.title: Load balancing briefly explained - campanainfo.com
item.description: Load balancing spreads workloads across multiple computing resources, such as servers, to maximize the utilization of resources.

item.title: TXT record - What is it? - campanainfo.com
item.description: The TXT record is a resource record in the Domain Name System (DNS) that allows associating text information with a hostname or domain name.

item.title: Why are DNS terms important? - campanainfo.com
item.description: Expanding your knowledge of DNS terms can provide insight into the underlying processes. It is crucial to begin with the basic concepts.

item.title: What does FTP mean? - campanainfo.com
item.description: FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol and is a widely-used standard for transferring files between devices over a TCP-based network.

item.title: SPF record - Definition - campanainfo.com
item.description: The SPF record, is a type of DNS record that specifies which mail servers are authorized to send emails on behalf of a precise domain.
